channels.description: Tara is a third generation sheep farmer raising her own sheep for meat. She makes hilarious youtube videos about daily farm life on her 4000 acre family farm in Victoria, Australia.

channels.name: Jet Lag: The Game
channels.description: Super fun travel channel where a group of friends travel to different countries playing tag, hide and seek, capture the flag etc across an entire country. They utilise a deck of cards they have created (and sell) that have challenges and curses to help or hinder them as they travel.
